title: Offences in forest reserves
rule: Entering a reserve, or doing an act banned by s. 26, without an existing right, permit or lawful authority is an offence.
points: Also an offence: blocking roads, paths or watercourses; hiding or removing tree stumps; damaging boundary marks or notice boards.
Being in or near a reserve with cutting tools, without lawful excuse, is an offence. The burden is on the person.
Livestock found in a reserve are presumed to be there with the owner's authority.
penalty: Fine of TSh 30,000 to 1,000,000, or up to 2 years in prison, or both.
